roles.input: Declared trusted setup plus ordered actual source calls; ordinary-world cases call actual complete production assembler and step. Signature setups initialize their private source runtime with installed afterWeapons(0); bog base is an explicitly installed trusted movement modifier and floor is witnessed through actual step displacement.
roles.expected: Actual legacy source output only; never computed from Rust.
roles.private: constructor, RNG draws, runtime paths/history/slip/ledger/clocks/credit/stats are server-private parity evidence, not client data.
roles.nonfinite: Non-finite numbers encoded as exact strings.
roles.rng: All runs use deterministic explicit mulberry32(3) tape; draws recorded in exact order; reward=[1,2,3,4],quest=[5,6,7,8]; no entropy sources.
prerequisiteGaps: Full Frost/Sentenced regional NPC cases captured even where native constructor admission is not yet implemented.
Locked arena gate behavior captured even where native arena/gate runtime is not admitted.
